services.name: Kayak Rentals
services.desc: Kayaks are rented out by the hour, for a half day or a full day. We have multiple single kayaks and two double kayaks. Explore the river with friends, family, or take a solo trip. Go bird watching, fishing, exploring, or swimming. You are welcome to bring a cooler, food, fishing poles (must have valid fishing license), and swim suits. We provide all life jackets and paddles. Don't forget your sunblock/hats/sunglasses! services.name: Pontoon Boat
services.desc: Our pontoon boat, "Black Betty," is a 20 ft, 2010 Bennington. The pontoon is ideal for relaxing or partying on the Guadalupe River. It holds 8-10 people, but is based on weight so can hold more if there are more children aboard. Each cruise is catered to you, whether you want to relax and site see, party with your friends, bring a bachelorette party, or hang out and swim. You are welcome to bring a cooler, food, and floats. Alcohol is allowed on the boat, but no glass containers allowed. We provide all lifejackets and a splash pad is available to rent. We do not pull a tube or wakeboard behind the pontoon. services.name: Ski Boat Rental
services.desc: Our ski boat, "Miss Pearl," is a 2000 Malibu Wakesetter. The ski boat is ideal for wake boarding, wake surfing, water skiing, tubing, etc. The boat holds 8-10 people, but is based on weight so can hold more if there are more children aboard. Each cruise is catered to you, you choose what activities you'd like to do and for how long. You are welcome to bring a cooler, food, and gear. Alcohol is allowed on the boat, although not recommended while doing water activities. No glass containers allowed. We provide all lifejackets as well as a surf board, wake board, and water skis.
